item.title: Benjamin Moore's 2027 Color of the Year is Webster Green. Here's how much paint a door, a room or a drenched study takes
item.description: Benjamin Moore just named Webster Green (HC-130) its 2027 Color of the Year. What the color is, where Benjamin Moore says to use it, and exactly how much paint to buy.

item.title: Roof replacement costs are up by a third. Measure your roof before you call for quotes
item.description: A new roof cost about 33% more in 2025 than the four years before, and prices are still rising. Why, and how to measure your roof in "squares" so you can compare quotes line by line.

item.title: Porcelain, pedestal and 'slurry' pavers: the patio trends people are searching this fall, explained
item.description: Searches for pedestal pavers and slurry pavers are climbing. What these words mean, how porcelain pavers compare with classic concrete ones, and what to know before laying a patio as the weather cools.

item.title: Kelly Ripa's glossy black kitchen floor has everyone asking: are dark floors back?
item.description: A celebrity kitchen just sent searches for dark kitchen flooring through the roof. What's trending underfoot for 2026–27, the honest pros and cons of dark floors, and how much flooring a kitchen really needs.

item.title: Is October too late to plant grass seed? What turf experts actually say
item.description: "Is it too late to plant grass seed?" is one of the fastest-rising lawn searches right now. The honest answer by grass type and region, the dormant-seeding trick, and what to do with all those leaves.

item.title: Celery is the 2027 Color of the Year. Here's how much paint a Celery room really takes
item.description: Sherwin-Williams picked Celery (SW 6421), Behr went olive, and searches for the new greens are surging. What the 2027 colors are, where they work, and exactly how much to buy.
